build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm --filter @agenthub/local-runtime build && pnpm prepare:sidecar && pnpm dev
build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm --filter @agenthub/local-runtime build && pnpm prepare:sidecar && pnpm build

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
security.devCsp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost ws://127.0.0.1:1420; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
